products.name: Tesla Optimus
products.note: Humanoid robot; factory automation; physical safety; worker interaction; liability

reading.body:
Tesla appears here as an AI company by virtue of a single product: Optimus, a humanoid robot categorized under Emerging and Frontier AI, with noted dimensions of factory automation, physical safety, worker interaction, and liability.

The categorization reflects where the real complexity sits. Humanoid robots in factory settings are not software products. They require physical infrastructure, continuous power, and integration with existing production lines. The liability and worker interaction notes signal that the constraints on deployment are not only technical but operational and legal.

The data covers product category and company profile only. It says nothing about compute requirements, energy draw, or any data center infrastructure Tesla operates or plans to operate. A reader cannot draw conclusions from this record about grid exposure or power scaling. What it does establish is that Tesla is present in this ecosystem as a hardware-forward AI company, and that Optimus is its sole listed AI product.
